# FIDES API and MCP

> Public machine-readable access to the FIDES Ecosystem Explorer for applications and AI agents.

Base URL: https://api.fides.community/

## Discovery

- [API landing page](https://api.fides.community/)
- [Catalog discovery](https://api.fides.community/api/public/catalogs)
- [OpenAPI discovery](https://api.fides.community/openapi.json)
- [Documentation index](https://api.fides.community/docs)

The catalog-discovery response is the authoritative list of configured catalogs and includes each catalog's list endpoint, detail-path pattern, OpenAPI document, and Swagger UI.

## MCP

- Endpoint: `https://api.fides.community/api/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: none; the service exposes public, read-only catalog data

The MCP server exposes compact, paginated search results and detailed lookup tools. Tool annotations mark operations as read-only, non-destructive, and idempotent. Available capabilities include wallets, credential types, organizations, issuers, relying parties, real-world use cases, terminology, and public FIDES site content.

## REST catalogs

- [Credential types](https://api.fides.community/api/public/credentialtype)
- [Organizations](https://api.fides.community/api/public/organization)
- [Issuers](https://api.fides.community/api/public/issuer)
- [Wallets](https://api.fides.community/api/public/wallet)
- [Relying parties](https://api.fides.community/api/public/rp)
- [Use cases](https://api.fides.community/api/public/usecase)

Use the individual OpenAPI documents returned by catalog discovery for parameters and response schemas. Prefer pagination and narrow filters; do not bulk-download complete catalogs unnecessarily.

## Usage

- Send standard JSON-RPC MCP messages to the MCP endpoint with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`.
- For REST integrations, use the documented list and detail endpoints.
- Preserve canonical detail URLs and FIDES attribution in user-facing results.
- Treat catalog content as discovery information, not certification or legal advice.
- Observe fair-use and applicable plan limits.

- [Terms of Service](https://fides.community/terms/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://fides.community/privacy/)
